name: ont-074-fixture-catalog
description: e2e fixture repo for ONT-074: one Prisma model carrying the three scalars whose JS values are not their declared type (DateTime, Decimal, BigInt) plus the String column a where clause reads, so a live run can prove that a drifted field refuses and that a Date/Decimal/BigInt row does not. Copied OUT OF REPO so the Prisma-major probe reads the node_modules the scenario plants rather than the monorepo's own.
